description: This file implements thread pool and task worker pool classes for managing worker threads, including creation, stopping, and synchronization mechanisms, with support for prioritized and non-prioritized task queues.

classes.name: detail::base_worker_pool
classes.description: Base class managing a pool of worker threads, handling thread creation, CPU affinity, and thread membership checks.

classes.name: priority_task_worker_pool
classes.description: Derived class managing a prioritized task worker thread pool with stop and wait functionalities.

classes.name: task_worker_pool
classes.description: Template class managing a non-prioritized task worker thread pool with stop and wait functionalities, specialized for different queue policies.

methods.name: worker_task_factory
methods.description: Factory function creating worker tasks that set execution context and process jobs from a queue.

methods.name: base_worker_pool::base_worker_pool
methods.description: Constructor initializing worker threads with optional CPU affinity masks.

methods.name: base_worker_pool::is_in_thread_pool
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is part of the worker thread pool.

methods.name: priority_task_worker_pool::stop
methods.description: Stops all worker threads and requests the queue to stop.

methods.name: priority_task_worker_pool::wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits until all pending tasks are completed and workers are synchronized.

methods.name: task_worker_pool::stop
methods.description: Stops all worker threads and requests the queue to stop.

methods.name: task_worker_pool::wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits until all pending tasks are completed and workers are synchronized, with additional caller notification.
